io.ncbpfluffybear.fluffymachines.utils

Class CompatUtils

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.ncbpfluffybear.fluffymachines.utils.CompatUtils

  • public final class CompatUtils
extends java.lang.Object
    Java-8 universal port: reflective guards around Bukkit API members that only exist on MC 1.13+/1.14+ (RecipeChoice, Material.isAir(), Tag, BlockData, ItemMeta.hasCustomModelData(), the persistent-data container). On servers without them (1.8–1.12) these helpers degrade gracefully instead of throwing NoSuchMethodError/NoClassDefFoundError.
